code: import os import json import time import random import re from datetime import datetime from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright # ================= 配置区域 ================= # 目标URL BASE_URL = "https://www.chinabond.com.cn/xwgg/ggtz/xwgg_gsgg/gsgg_zytz_ath/" # 爬取时间范围 START_DATE = "2025-12-01" END_DATE = "2025-12-31" # 输出目录 OUTPUT_DIR = r"d:\llm_mcp_genpy\pygen\output" # ================= 工具函数 ================= def ensure_dir(path): if not os.path.exists(path): os.makedirs(path) def clean_date(date_str): """ 清洗日期格式，统一为 YYYY-MM-DD 支持格式: YYYY/MM/DD, YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY.MM.DD """ if not date_str: return "" date_str = date_str.strip() # 尝试匹配常见格式 match = re.search(r'(\d{4})[\/\.-](\d{1,2})[\/\.-](\d{1,2})', date_str) if match: return f"{match.group(1)}-{match.group(2).zfill(2)}-{match.group(3).zfill(2)}" return "" def clean_html_content(html_content, base_url): """ 清洗HTML内容： 1. 修复图片和链接的相对路径为绝对路径 2. 移除无用标签 """ if not html_content: return "" try: soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, 'html.parser') # 修复图片链接 for img in soup.find_all('img'): if img.get('src'): img['src'] = urljoin(base_url, img['src']) # 修复超链接 for a in soup.find_all('a'): if a.get('href'): a['href'] = urljoin(base_url, a['href']) # 移除脚本和样式 for script in soup(["script", "style"]): script.decompose() return str(soup) except Exception as e: print(f"[Warn] 内容清洗出错: {e}") return html_content def extract_article_content(page_content, url): """ 智能提取正文内容 """ soup = BeautifulSoup(page_content, 'html.parser') # 移除无关元素 for tag in soup(['script', 'style', 'iframe', 'noscript']): tag.decompose() # 1. 优先尝试常见的正文容器选择器 # 根据中国债券信息网的常见结构猜测 potential_selectors = [ '.article-content', '.TRS_Editor', '.content', '#content', '.xl_content', '.detail_content', 'div[style*="font-size"]' # 有些老网站直接在div上写样式 ] content_html = "" for selector in potential_selectors: element = soup.select_one(selector) if element and len(element.get_text(strip=True)) > 50: content_html = str(element) break # 2. 如果没找到，使用启发式算法：找字数最多的 div 或 td if not content_html: max_len = 0 best_elem = None # 遍历所有 div 和 td for tag_name in ['div', 'td', 'article']: for elem in soup.find_all(tag_name): # 排除导航、页脚等明显非正文区域 if any(cls in (elem.get('class') or []) for cls in ['header', 'footer', 'nav', 'menu', 'sidebar']): continue text_len = len(elem.get_text(strip=True)) if text_len > max_len: max_len = text_len best_elem = elem if best_elem and max_len > 100: # 至少要有一定长度 content_html = str(best_elem) return clean_html_content(content_html, url) def save_results(articles, output_path): """保存结果为JSON""" result = { "total": len(articles), "crawlTime": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "dateRange": { "start": START_DATE, "end": END_DATE }, "articles": articles } with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(result, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) print(f"[Success] 已保存 {len(articles)} 条新闻到 {output_path}") # ================= 爬虫主逻辑 ================= def crawl_chinabond_news(): ensure_dir(OUTPUT_DIR) # 启动 Playwright with sync_playwright() as p: # 配置浏览器，添加反爬参数 browser = p.chromium.launch( headless=True, # 设为 False 可观察浏览器行为 args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"] ) context = browser.new_context( viewport={'width': 1920, 'height': 1080}, user_agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" ) page = context.new_page() # 结果列表 all_articles = [] current_url = BASE_URL page_num = 1 has_next_page = True print(f"[Info] 开始爬取: {BASE_URL}") print(f"[Info] 目标日期范围: {START_DATE} 至 {END_DATE}") while has_next_page: print(f"\n[Processing] 正在处理第 {page_num} 页: {current_url}") try: page.goto(current_url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000) page.wait_for_timeout(2000) # 等待动态内容加载 # 解析列表页 content = page.content() soup = BeautifulSoup(content, 'html.parser') # 定位列表项 # 根据提供的HTML结构：div.rightListContent list_items = soup.select('div.rightListContent') if not list_items: print("[Warn] 未找到列表项，可能页面结构变化或加载失败") break page_valid_count = 0 stop_crawling = False for item in list_items: try: # 提取日期 date_elem = item.select_one('span.rightListTime') if not date_elem: continue raw_date = date_elem.get_text(strip=True) pub_date = clean_date(raw_date) if not pub_date: continue # 日期过滤逻辑 if pub_date > END_DATE: # 日期晚于结束时间，跳过（可能是置顶或未来预告） continue if pub_date < START_DATE: # 日期早于开始时间，停止爬取（假设列表按时间倒序） # 为了防止置顶文章干扰，这里可以设置一个计数器，连续多条不满足才退出 # 但通常新闻列表是严格倒序的，这里直接标记停止 print(f"[Info] 遇到早于开始日期的记录 ({pub_date})，停止翻页") stop_crawling = True break # 提取标题和链接 link_elem = item.select_one('span.rightListImport a') if not link_elem: continue title = link_elem.get_text(strip=True) href = link_elem.get('href') full_url = urljoin(current_url, href) # 添加到待爬取列表 article_info = { "title": title, "date": pub_date, "url": full_url, "source": "中国债券信息网", "sourceUrl": full_url } all_articles.append(article_info) page_valid_count += 1 print(f" -> 捕获: [{pub_date}] {title}") except Exception as e: print(f" [Error] 解析单条记录失败: {e}") continue if stop_crawling: break # 翻页逻辑 # 检查是否有下一页 # 策略：查找当前页码的下一个页码链接，或者直接构造URL # 提供的HTML中分页结构：1 2 # 通常第二页是 index_1.html, 第三页是 index_2.html # 尝试查找下一页按钮或链接 next_page_link = None # 方法1：查找包含 "下一页" 或 ">" 的链接 # 方法2：查找当前页码+1的链接 next_page_num = page_num + 1 # 在 soup 中查找文本为 str(next_page_num) 的 a 标签 next_page_elem = soup.find('a', string=str(next_page_num), class_='pageNum') if next_page_elem and next_page_elem.get('href'): next_href = next_page_elem.get('href') current_url = urljoin(BASE_URL, next_href) page_num += 1 else: # 尝试构造 URL (静态分页常见模式) # 首页是 index.html, 第2页通常是 index_1.html # 注意：有些CMS是 index_{page-1}.html if page_num == 1: next_url = urljoin(BASE_URL, "index_1.html") else: next_url = urljoin(BASE_URL, f"index_{page_num}.html") # 验证构造的URL是否存在（简单判断：如果当前页已经是最后一页，通常没有下一页链接） # 这里我们尝试访问，如果页面内容重复或404则停止 # 更稳妥的是看页面上有没有 "下一页" 按钮 # 检查页面底部的 "下一页" 按钮 next_btn = soup.select_one('a.pageNext') if next_btn and next_btn.get('href'): current_url = urljoin(BASE_URL, next_btn.get('href')) page_num += 1 elif page_valid_count > 0: # 如果当前页有数据，且没找到明确的下一页按钮，尝试构造 # 但为了安全，如果找不到明确链接，最好停止，避免死循环 # 根据提供的HTML，2 没有 href，说明可能是 JS 翻页或者 href 被省略 # 如果 href 缺失，说明可能需要点击 # 尝试使用 Playwright 点击下一页 try: # 查找文本为下一页页码的元素 next_locator = page.get_by_text(str(next_page_num), exact=True) if next_locator.count() > 0 and next_locator.first.is_visible(): # 获取 href 属性 href = next_locator.first.get_attribute('href') if href: current_url = urljoin(BASE_URL, href) page_num += 1 else: # 可能是 JS 点击 print("[Info] 尝试点击翻页...") next_locator.first.click() page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle') current_url = page.url # 更新当前URL page_num += 1 else: print("[Info] 未找到下一页链接，停止翻页") has_next_page = False except Exception as e: print(f"[Warn] 翻页操作失败: {e}") has_next_page = False else: has_next_page = False except Exception as e: print(f"[Error] 处理列表页失败: {e}") break print(f"\n[Info] 列表抓取完成，共获取 {len(all_articles)} 条记录。开始抓取详情页...") # 抓取详情页内容 for i, article in enumerate(all_articles): print(f"[{i+1}/{len(all_articles)}] 正在抓取: {article['title']}") try: page.goto(article['url'], wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=20000) # 随机等待，模拟人类行为 time.sleep(random.uniform(1, 2)) content = page.content() article['content'] = extract_article_content(content, article['url']) # 简单的摘要提取 soup_detail = BeautifulSoup(article['content'], 'html.parser') text = soup_detail.get_text(strip=True) article['summary'] = text[:200] + "..." if len(text) > 200 else text except Exception as e: print(f" [Error] 抓取详情页失败: {e}") article['content'] = "" article['summary'] = "" browser.close() # 保存结果 timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S") filename = f"chinabond_news_{timestamp}.json" output_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, filename) save_results(all_articles, output_path) if __name__ == "__main__": main_start = time.time() crawl_chinabond_news() print(f"\n[Done] 任务完成，耗时: {time.time() - main_start:.2f} 秒")
